Opp. ... on 29 June, 2018 Author: Ananda Sen Bench: Ananda Sen In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi B.A. No. 5034 of 2018 1. Nazir Mian @ Najir Mian 2. Munna Ansari @ Md. Maniruddin Ansari 3 . Md. Israfil Ray @ Md. Israfil @ Israf Ray .... .... Petitioner(s). Versus The State of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. Party(s) ------ Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ananda Sen. ------ For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Faisad Alam, Advocate For the State : A.P.P. ......... 02/29.06.2018
texts.facts: Due to inadvertence, the same has been annexed and submission to that effect that he is also not relying on sub-para-4 of Para 13 of the statement of this petitioner. Counsel for the petitioners submits that some camels were confiscated and they were entrusted to this petitioner and others. These petitioners and others were directed to produce the said animals but they could not produce the same. It is presumed that petitioners have slaughtered the animals.
texts.arguments: The petitioners are accused for allegedly committing an offence punishable under Sections 429, 406, 188, 120-B/34 IPC and u/s 11(a) (d) (e) (i) (k) of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and Rule 3 of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Slaughter House) Rules, 2001 and Section 55 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. Counsel for the petitioners submits that he is not relying on Annexure-3/2. He submits that petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The petitioners are accused for allegedly committing an offence punishable under Sections 429, 406, 188, 120-B/34 IPC and u/s 11(a) (d) (e) (i) (k) of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and Rule 3 of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Slaughter House) Rules, 2001 and Section 55 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. Counsel for the petitioners submits that he is not relying on Annexure-3/2.
texts.respondent_arguments: He submits that petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.
